decisions.reason: 九年六月，有桑生於宮西廂，日長尺餘，數日而枯。 dates the growth and withering of a mulberry in the palace west wing. Sima Yu is neither actor nor named participant. Narrative placement in his biography does not make this his activity; preserve the source event and all evidence without guessing his personal year.

武帝愛之 states affection without an absolute date. The research sentence describes lack of a date, not an unresolved explicitly dated personal event. Empty hints are correct; neither the full reign nor invented bounded activity is warranted. Other supplied excerpts about Emperor Wu are also undated.

The sixth lunar month, growth of more than one chi daily, and withering after several days are factual content omitted from the current idiomatic field. Compression is legitimate style only while retaining these facts; omen is interpretive, not an explicit word in this sentence. 西廂 means the palace west wing or western side chamber, not west of the halls.

west of the palace relocates 宮西廂. Retain sixth month (not Gregorian June), ninth year, over one chi per day, and withering after several days in original sequence. Literal wording already broadly contains growth/withering but should make the temporal sequence exact.

suggestedFaithfulRendering: In the sixth month of the ninth year, a mulberry sprang up in the palace’s west wing. It grew more than one chi each day and withered after several days.
limits: Narrow independent source and paired-field judgment only. No chapter/date approval, blanket editorial flag clearing, canonical mutation, fresh fingerprints, or reuse of prior date approvals.
